paper.title: Scaling Agent Learning via Experience Synthesis
paper.central_claim: A reasoning-based experience model synthesizing transitions and rewards, with a co-evolving replay buffer and a reward-entropy curriculum task generator, enables scalable online agent RL and sim-to-real transfer.

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref not exposed to the worker in this runtime; model_type recorded as configured by controller.

evidence.quote: The collected rollouts are used with standard RL algorithms
evidence.support_explanation: Synthetic rollouts feed PPO/GRPO updates of the agent policy; the retained product is agent weights.

evidence.quote: and perform full-parameter fine-tuning for all three agent backbones in our experiments.
evidence.support_explanation: Agents are trained by full-parameter fine-tuning.

evidence.quote: leverages an experience replay buffer initialized with offline real-world data and continuously enriched with fresh interactions to actively support agent training.
evidence.support_explanation: The replay buffer is retrieval context for the weight-trained experience model (simulator), not a harness component of the evaluated agent.

evidence.quote: achieve success rates exceeding 30% across all backbones
evidence.support_explanation: Author-reported WebArena result for purely synthetic training; other environments in Table 1-2.

signatures.object: Agent policy weights, trained on rollouts produced by an SFT-trained reasoning experience model acting as a synthetic environment.
signatures.information: Experience model sees state-action history, task instruction and top-k similar replay-buffer trajectories; agent sees synthetic states; real environment seen only in S2R phase.
signatures.operation: Experience model predicts next state and reward by chain-of-thought; tasks with high reward variance are selected and varied by the same model (curriculum); agent updated by PPO/GRPO.
signatures.output: Updated agent weights (and, for the simulator, SFT weights).
signatures.conditions: Text-abstracted state space; offline trajectories to train experience model (WebShop, ALFWorld, WebArena).
signatures.feedback: Experience-model reward; reward entropy for task selection.
signatures.later_use: Later RL iterations; optional sim-to-real RL.
signatures.claimed_effect: Matches GRPO/PPO trained on 80K real transitions with synthetic rollouts only; S2R improves further (author_report).
signatures.failure_boundary: Single-environment setups, GPT-4o judge for experience quality, no robustness to large domain gaps (Sec 5.2).

gap.author_gap: RL for LLM agents is blocked by costly rollouts, scarce tasks, unreliable rewards and infrastructure; synthesize experiences.
gap.lineage: World-model-based agent training, AgentSynth task synthesis, Verl-Agent RL.
gap.method_response: Reasoning experience model + replay buffer + entropy-based curriculum task generation.
